scene: A robot sky-valet appears, summoning three unique aerial rides to the edge.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the observation deck. On the far left, a winged flying scooter floats idle. Left of centre, a red double-decker hover bus hovers level with the deck. In the centre, the grandmother stands with her white dog beside the counter, while a striped gondola drone bobs docked on the far right.
shown: a gleaming winged scooter floating near the railing on the far left
a red double-decker hover bus hovering beside the platform on the left
an ornate striped gondola drone docked at the railing on the far right
